title: Lemongrass {p} with {v}
steps: Press the {p} between towels under a weight for 15 minutes, then cube it and dust with a little cornstarch. Pan-fry in hot oil 6 to 8 minutes, until golden and crisp on all sides. Move to a plate.
In the same pan, cook a spoonful of minced lemongrass (or lemon zest), garlic and sliced chili 1 to 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the {sauce} and a pinch of sugar, return the {p} and toss 1 minute, until glazed. Off the heat, toss in the {spice}.
Serve hot with the {v} over the {s}.
tip: Go heavy on the vegetables and light on the oil.
